{
    "content": "<p>I'm putting together a server for some friends to play Unreal Tournament (yes,\nthe original). I had heard this was doable on Linux, and I have a friend's old\nlaptop here to play with. I'll be putting good links here that have helped me to\nget this working.</p>\n<p>I got it all setup in a VirtualBox VM, but need it\non the separate machine. This old laptop has a broken screen and no hard\ndrive...no problem! It will be running headless anyway, and I've also got a 16GB\nflash drive. Ubuntu Lucid installs fine on a flash drive - the only\nrecommendation being that you use ext2, as it's not a journaling file system (it\ndoesn't write as much to the drive).</p>\n<h2>Helpful Links</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"http://piotr.gabryjeluk.pl/dev:playing-unreal-tournament-on-ubuntu-lucid\">Playing Unreal Tournament on Ubuntu Lucid</a></li>\n<li><a href=\"http://ut.congiman.com/settingup.html\">Unreal Tournament Server Setup for Linux</a></li>\n<li><a href=\"https://github.com/liflg\">Loki Installers for Linux Gamers</a></li>\n</ul>\n",
